title: Contemporary Tangkhul Poetry Anthology (Field Collection)
title_translation: Unpublished Village Poetry and Monologue Candidate Collection
creator: Tangkhul Youth Writers Circle
author: Various Contemporary Poets
notes: Candidate collection of contemporary unpublished village poetry compiled during fieldwork; awaiting individual author clearance and formal orthographic review.
indigenous_tangkhul_text: Contemporary Tangkhul Youth Writers Circle-na village fieldwork-li unpublished modern poems and monologues compile sakya.
Modern urban identity, mountain environmental ecology, social justice, kala digital era-wui youth reflections explore sakya.
Candidate collection-hi individual poet clearance kala formal orthographic review-wui pending status-li pama.
english_translation_text: Compiled during village fieldwork in 2020, this candidate collection gathers unpublished poems by emerging Tangkhul writers.
Exploring modern urban identity, mountain ecology, social justice, and the dilemmas of youth in the digital era.
This candidate anthology is catalogued under ethical community protocols awaiting individual clearance and orthographic review.
literary_themes: Contemporary 21st-century youth poetry and free-verse innovation
Environmental preservation of the fragile hill ridges and forests
Diaspora identity and nostalgic yearning for ancestral roots
structure_and_meter: Contemporary free verse, experimental line breaks, and conversational poetic monologues.
critical_commentary: Represents the active cutting edge of contemporary Tangkhul creative writing, bridging oral heritage with 21st-century global poetics.

poetic_vocabulary_terms.Kathara-Laa: Contemporary free verse / modern poetic composition
poetic_vocabulary_terms.Ramvum-Leishat: Nostalgic yearning for the ancestral soil
poetic_vocabulary_terms.Mayarnao-Ning: The youthful consciousness of the new generation
